leap.summary: Across 5,384 consecutive-season pairs (1996-97→2025-26, both seasons in that year's top-250 fantasy pool), no age or experience year shows a leap: the average O1 gain is largest straight after the rookie year (year 2: +2.65, n=372) and shrinks steadily after that, with no bucket significantly above both of its neighbours. Gains run out at age 27 / year 7 (age 27 mean -0.18, n=509), and the first significant decline is at age 29 (-0.54, 95% CI -0.95 to -0.14, n=451) and experience year 7 (-0.48, CI -0.86 to -0.10, n=499).
